holdings.research_note: Fingerprints are held only temporarily: by law they are deleted from the issuance registers 15 days after the document is delivered, or 90 days after issue if it is not delivered. They stay long-term only on the document chip. No long-term central fingerprint store for documents exists under ZOIzk-1C or ZPL. Police identification records (ZNPPol) are a separate matter and are not covered here.
